initialExam.title: Railway Ministerial & Isolated Categories 2026
initialExam.description: Recruitment for ministerial and isolated category posts in Indian Railways including Junior Accounts Assistant, Senior Clerk, Stenographer, and other administrative positions.
initialExam.qualifications: Bachelor's Degree with typing proficiency for some posts
initialExam.syllabus: General Awareness, Arithmetic, General Intelligence & Reasoning, General English. Typing/Stenography skill test for applicable posts.
initialExam.examPattern: CBT: 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes. Skill Test (Typing/Stenography) for applicable posts.
initialExam.selectionProcess: CBT → Skill Test (if applicable) → Document Verification → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Junior Accounts Assistant, Senior Clerk, Stenographer in Railway offices
initialExam.careerGrowth: Junior Clerk → Senior Clerk → Head Clerk → Office Superintendent → Chief OS.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit rrbcdg.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical, Free Railway Pass, Pension

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
